name: a ghost's promise
source:
A ghost's promise is a short kinetic novel about a boy learning to move on from the past into the bleak future. It is the prologue to a broken promise.

[From [url=https://somnari.itch.io/a-ghosts-promise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《幽灵的诺言》（a ghost's promise）是一部短篇电子小说，讲述了一名少年学会走出过往阴霾、迈向苍凉未来的故事。本作是《破碎的诺言》（a broken promise）的序章。

[摘自[url=https://somnari.itch.io/a-ghosts-promise]itch.io[/url]]
